research-cycle.purpose: Scope, route, sequence dependencies and account for coverage.

stock-initiation.purpose: Establish new coverage; existing coverage uses the revision entry.

model-revision.purpose: Preserve the prior baseline, classify evidence and attribute changes.

evidence-intake.purpose: Identity, cutoff, official sources, original observations, conflicts and data availability.

company-model.purpose: Business/competition and sector mechanism, history, foundational drivers, guidance, linked forecasts and Excel; regular reviews may reuse the valid forecast.

corporate-governance.purpose: Control, minority access, conduct, allocation and continuing issues; reuse unaffected dated findings after eligibility review.

financial-quality.purpose: Early red flags, pre-valuation model audit and post-valuation thesis validation; reuse unaffected passes, reopen invalidated ones.

valuation-thesis.purpose: Business-suited valuation, expectations, scenarios and justified calendar/market changes.

research-challenge.purpose: Counter-case, pivotal source/calculation checks and assumptions that can break the decision.

investment-conviction.purpose: Preserve and test the decisive belief or avoidance condition separately from value and price.

investment-conclusion.purpose: Target/date, price-based rating, attractiveness, eligibility and decision-changing evidence.

research-brief.purpose: Requested pitch or update, numerical/prose consistency and linked technical support.

monitor-review.purpose: Next decisive observations, milestones and learning; planning does not activate monitoring.

company-change-tracking.purpose: Comparable observation/change ledger and frozen forecast-to-actual learning.
company-change-tracking.trigger: Existing-coverage review, or a historical change/surprise chain that materially informs initiation.

macro-event-analysis.purpose: Regime, sector, FX/rate/cost transmission and investor-base effects.
macro-event-analysis.trigger: The proportionate context scan finds a material exposure, scenario, access or repricing question; no standalone macro deep dive is required otherwise.

theme-screening.purpose: Universe discovery, financial/peer triage or value-chain candidate selection.
theme-screening.trigger: The request needs discovery, a shortlist or candidate comparison; researching a named stock does not itself require a universe screen.

chart-visualization.purpose: Data-linked, consistently themed research charts and explanatory diagrams.
chart-visualization.trigger: The requested deliverable contains charts or diagrams; a concise text-only update need not manufacture a visual.

issuer-questions.purpose: Answerable questions linked to unresolved material assumptions, prior answers and verification.
issuer-questions.trigger: An unanswered issuer question can change the decision after checking available evidence; drafting does not authorize contact.

industry-analysis.purpose: Establish industry economics before operating forecasts and refresh decision-relevant indicators in every review; reuse unaffected dated analysis with current evidence checks.

report-layout.purpose: Apply the shared A4 full-report renderer, source/exhibit conventions and page review without replacing the brief template.
report-layout.trigger: A full visual stock report is requested or required by the chosen initiation deliverable; narrow notes and one-page-only requests use their own formats.
